question: What was the effective tax rate, and what drove the difference from the U.S. statutory rate?

answer.summary: Walmart's effective income tax rate was 25.5% for fiscal 2024 [F00872], down from 33.6% in fiscal 2023 [F00873] and 25.4% in fiscal 2022 [F00874]. The elevated FY2023 rate was primarily driven by the tax impact of the business reorganization resulting in the full separation of PhonePe from Flipkart [T00460]. Income tax expense for FY2024 was $5.58B [F00042] on pre-tax income of $21.85B [F00039]. The FY2024 rate normalized back to FY2022 levels once the one-time reorganization impact was removed.
drivers: FY2023: business reorganization resulting in full separation of PhonePe from Flipkart (primary driver of the 33.6% vs 25.4%/25.5% spread) [T00460]

Other potential rate drivers mentioned: changes in assessment of unrecognized tax benefits, valuation allowances, changes in tax law, outcomes of administrative audits, and impact of discrete items [T00460]
FY2024: removal of the one-time reorganization tax impact returned the rate to FY2022-like levels [T00460]
risks_and_red_flags: Effective tax rate may fluctuate as a result of various factors including unrecognized tax benefit assessments, valuation allowances, tax law changes, audit outcomes, and discrete items [T00460]
Realization of certain net deferred tax assets and effects of resolutions of tax-related matters remain a risk [T00067]
Discrete events such as audit settlements or tax law changes are recognized in the period they occur, creating potential volatility [T00701]
data_quality_notes: The retrieved evidence does not contain the U.S. statutory tax rate figure itself, nor a detailed line-item reconciliation of the rate difference; only the narrative identifies the PhonePe/Flipkart reorganization as the primary driver [T00460]

The FY2024 attribution block breaks down income tax expense into current ($5.75B, 103.1% of total) and deferred (-$171.00M, -3.1% of total) components [F00830][F00842], but this does not explain the statutory-rate difference
